note: mc-cmdlab snippet library. kind=function: lines (one data pack function); also = helper functions it calls (add them as modules with these ids). kind=blocks: blocks + origin/facing/trigger/expect_success. kind=steps: script steps. variants[version] overrides lines/also/blocks/steps for that version. Functions use the namespace game:.

categories.ja: プレイヤー・アイテム
コマンドブロックの型

snippets.title_ja: 赤と青のチームを作る
snippets.desc_ja: 色・名前の前の印・同士討ちなし・味方の透明が見える設定まで。
snippets.desc_en: Colors, name prefix, no friendly fire, see invisible teammates.
snippets.notes_ja: 2回目の team add は「既にある」と返るだけで害はありません。
snippets.notes_en: Running team add twice only says the team already exists.

snippets.title_ja: 全員を赤・青に均等に分ける
snippets.title_en: Split everyone evenly into red and blue
snippets.desc_ja: チームに入っていない人を1人ずつ交互に入れ、残りがいる間は自分を呼び直す。
snippets.desc_en: Puts one unassigned player in each team, then calls itself while someone is left.
lines: execute if entity @a[team=] run team join blue @r[team=]
execute if entity @a[team=] run function game:assign_even
snippets.notes_ja: 部品の id を assign_even にして保存してください(自分を呼ぶため)。人数が奇数なら赤が1人多くなります。先に team leave @a で全員を外すと分け直せます。
snippets.notes_en: Save it with module id assign_even (it calls itself). With an odd count red gets one more. Run team leave @a first to re-split.

snippets.title_ja: ランダムに1人を鬼、残りを逃げる側に
snippets.title_en: Pick one random hunter, the rest run
snippets.desc_ja: @r で1人だけ選び、残り全員を別のチームへ。
snippets.desc_en: @r picks one player; everyone else joins the other team.

snippets.title_ja: 名札・押し合い・死亡メッセージを隠す
snippets.title_en: Hide name tags, collisions and death messages
snippets.desc_ja: 隠れんぼや鬼ごっこでよく使うチームの設定。
snippets.desc_en: Team options often used for hide-and-seek and tag.
snippets.notes_ja: 値は never / always が両方の版で同じ書き方です。相手チームだけに隠す値は版で綴りが変わるので、エディタの点検で確かめてください。
snippets.notes_en: never / always are spelled the same in every version. The 'hide for other teams' value changed spelling between versions, so check it in the editor.

snippets.title_ja: チームの人数を数える
snippets.desc_ja: execute store result で人数をスコアに入れ、0人なら知らせる。
snippets.desc_en: Store each team's head count in a score and react when a team is empty.
lines: execute store result score #red_n game if entity @a[team=red,gamemode=!spectator]
execute store result score #blue_n game if entity @a[team=blue,gamemode=!spectator]
execute if score #red_n game matches 0 run tellraw @a {"text":"赤チームは全滅","color":"red"}
execute if score #blue_n game matches 0 run tellraw @a {"text":"青チームは全滅","color":"blue"}

snippets.title_ja: チームを空にする
snippets.desc_ja: 試合のあとに全員をチームから外す。
snippets.desc_en: Remove everyone from every team after a round.

snippets.title_ja: 右側(サイドバー)に得点を出す
snippets.desc_ja: 表示名つきの項目を作り、チームの得点を名前つきで並べる。
snippets.desc_en: An objective with a display name, with team totals as named entries.
lines: scoreboard objectives add points dummy {"text":"得点","color":"gold"}
snippets.notes_ja: # で始まる名前(#time など)はサイドバーに出ません。見せたいものは Red のように普通の名前にします。
snippets.notes_en: Names starting with # (like #time) are hidden from the sidebar; use plain names like Red for shown entries.

snippets.title_ja: 名前の下と Tab にハートで体力
snippets.title_en: Health as hearts below names and in Tab
snippets.desc_ja: 体力の項目を作り、名前の下と Tab 一覧に出す。表示の枠の名前が版で違う。
snippets.desc_en: A health objective shown below names and in the Tab list. The slot name differs by version.

lines: scoreboard objectives modify hp rendertype hearts
scoreboard objectives modify hp rendertype hearts

snippets.notes_ja: 1.20.1 は belowName、1.20.2 以降は below_name。体力は一度ダメージを受けるまで 0 と出ることがあります。
snippets.notes_en: 1.20.1 uses belowName, 1.20.2+ uses below_name. Health may show 0 until the player is hurt once.

snippets.title_ja: キル数・デス数を数える
snippets.desc_ja: プレイヤーを倒した数と死んだ数を自動で数え、Tab と横に出す。
snippets.desc_en: Kills and deaths counted by the game, shown in Tab and the sidebar.
lines: scoreboard objectives add kills playerKillCount {"text":"キル"}
scoreboard objectives add deaths deathCount {"text":"デス"}

snippets.title_ja: チームごとに違うサイドバー
snippets.desc_ja: 赤チームの人にだけ見えるサイドバーを出す。
snippets.desc_en: A sidebar only red team members see.
lines: scoreboard objectives add red_info dummy {"text":"赤チームの情報","color":"red"}
scoreboard objectives add blue_info dummy {"text":"青チームの情報","color":"blue"}

snippets.title_ja: 数字を隠す・行の名前を変える(1.20.3+)
snippets.desc_ja: サイドバーを文字だけの掲示板にする。
snippets.desc_en: Turn the sidebar into a text-only board.
lines: scoreboard objectives add board dummy {"text":"ミッション","color":"gold"}
scoreboard objectives modify board numberformat blank
scoreboard players display name line1 board {"text":"ボタンを押せ","color":"yellow"}
scoreboard players display name line2 board {"text":"残り 3 個","color":"white"}
snippets.notes_ja: numberformat と display name は 1.20.3 から。1.20.1 では使えません。
snippets.notes_en: numberformat and display name start in 1.20.3; not in 1.20.1.

snippets.title_ja: スコアの計算(定数・割り算・余り)
snippets.desc_ja: 秒を分と秒に分ける。定数は #20 のような名前に入れておく。
snippets.desc_en: Split seconds into minutes and seconds; keep constants in names like #60.

snippets.title_ja: tick を数えて1秒ごとに減らす
snippets.title_en: Count ticks, take one second off every 20
snippets.desc_ja: 毎 tick 呼ぶと、20 tick ごとに残り時間(#time)が1減る。
snippets.desc_en: Called every tick, it lowers the time left (#time) once per 20 ticks.
lines: execute if score #state game matches 2 run scoreboard players add #ticks game 1
execute if score #ticks game matches 20.. run scoreboard players remove #time game 1
execute if score #ticks game matches 20.. run scoreboard players set #ticks game 0
execute if score #state game matches 2 if score #time game matches ..0 run title @a title {"text":"時間切れ","color":"red"}
execute if score #state game matches 2 if score #time game matches ..0 run scoreboard players set #state game 3
snippets.notes_ja: 前もって scoreboard objectives add game dummy と #state=2・#time=秒数を入れておきます。
snippets.notes_en: Create the objective game and set #state to 2 and #time to the seconds first.

snippets.title_ja: ボスバーで残り時間
snippets.title_en: Time left on a boss bar
snippets.desc_ja: ボスバーを作り、毎 tick スコアの値を写す。
snippets.desc_en: Create a boss bar and copy the score into it every tick.

also.label_ja: ボスバーを更新(毎 tick)
lines: execute store result bossbar game:time value run scoreboard players get #time game
execute if score #time game matches ..30 run bossbar set game:time color red

snippets.notes_ja: max は試合の秒数に合わせます。後から入ったプレイヤーにも見せるなら players @a を毎回入れ直します。
snippets.notes_en: Set max to the round length. Re-run players @a to show it to players who join later.

snippets.title_ja: 3・2・1 のカウントダウン
snippets.desc_ja: #state=1 の間、毎 tick #cd を減らし、60・40・20 tick で数字と音、0 で開始。
snippets.desc_en: While #state is 1, lower #cd every tick; show 3, 2, 1 with a sound and start at 0.
lines: execute if score #state game matches 1 run scoreboard players remove #cd game 1
execute if score #state game matches 1 if score #cd game matches 60 run title @a title {"text":"3","color":"green"}
execute if score #state game matches 1 if score #cd game matches 40 run title @a title {"text":"2","color":"yellow"}
execute if score #state game matches 1 if score #cd game matches 20 run title @a title {"text":"1","color":"red"}
execute if score #state game matches 1 if score #cd game matches 20..60 run execute as @a at @s run playsound minecraft:block.note_block.pling master @s ~ ~ ~ 1 1
execute if score #state game matches 1 if score #cd game matches 0 run title @a title {"text":"スタート！","color":"gold"}
execute if score #state game matches 1 if score #cd game matches 0 run execute as @a at @s run playsound minecraft:entity.player.levelup master @s ~ ~ ~ 1 1
execute if score #state game matches 1 if score #cd game matches 0 run scoreboard players set #state game 2

also.label_ja: カウントダウンを始める

snippets.notes_ja: 音の行は 20〜60 の毎 tick 鳴るので、気になれば数字の行と同じく 60・40・20 に分けます。
snippets.notes_en: The sound line fires on every tick from 20 to 60; split it into 60/40/20 like the title lines if you prefer.

snippets.title_ja: アクションバーに 分:秒
snippets.desc_ja: #time を分と秒に分け、秒が1桁なら0を付けて出す。
snippets.desc_en: Split #time into minutes and seconds, padding seconds with 0.
lines: execute if score #sec game matches 10.. run title @a actionbar [{"text":"残り "},{"score":{"name":"#min","objective":"game"}},{"text":":"},{"score":{"name":"#sec","objective":"game"}}]
execute if score #sec game matches ..9 run title @a actionbar [{"text":"残り "},{"score":{"name":"#min","objective":"game"}},{"text":":0"},{"score":{"name":"#sec","objective":"game"}}]
snippets.notes_ja: objective game と const を先に作っておきます。
snippets.notes_en: Create the objectives game and const first.

snippets.title_ja: タイトル・サブタイトルを出す
snippets.desc_ja: 表示時間を決め、サブタイトル→タイトルの順に送る。
snippets.desc_en: Set the timing, then send the subtitle before the title.
snippets.notes_ja: タイトルを送った瞬間に画面に出るので、サブタイトルは先に送ります。times は tick(フェードイン・表示・フェードアウト)。
snippets.notes_en: The title appears the moment it is sent, so send the subtitle first. times is in ticks (fade in, stay, fade out).

snippets.title_ja: チャットにスコアと名前を出す
snippets.title_en: Chat with scores and player names
snippets.desc_ja: selector で名前、score で数字を文章に混ぜる。@s は execute as の相手。
snippets.desc_en: Mix names (selector) and numbers (score) into chat; @s is the execute as target.
lines: execute as @a run tellraw @s [{"text":"あなたのキル数: "},{"score":{"name":"@s","objective":"kills"},"color":"yellow"}]

snippets.title_ja: チームごとにアクションバー
snippets.desc_ja: チームで違う一言を画面の下に出し続ける。
snippets.desc_en: Keep a different line above the hotbar for each team.
lines: title @a[team=hunter] actionbar {"text":"逃走者を捕まえろ","color":"dark_red"}
title @a[team=runner] actionbar {"text":"ハンターから逃げろ","color":"green"}

snippets.title_ja: よく使う効果音
snippets.desc_ja: 各プレイヤーの位置で鳴らす。名前だけでテストでき、聞こえたかは heard で確かめられる。
snippets.desc_en: Played at each player's position. Check that it reached a player with the heard check.
lines: execute as @a at @s run playsound minecraft:entity.player.levelup master @s ~ ~ ~ 1 1
# カウントダウン(高い音)
execute as @a at @s run playsound minecraft:block.note_block.pling master @s ~ ~ ~ 1 2
execute as @a at @s run playsound minecraft:block.anvil.land master @s ~ ~ ~ 1 1
execute as @a at @s run playsound minecraft:entity.wither.spawn master @s ~ ~ ~ 1 1
execute as @a at @s run playsound minecraft:ui.toast.challenge_complete master @s ~ ~ ~ 1 1
execute as @a at @s run playsound minecraft:entity.experience_orb.pickup master @s ~ ~ ~ 1 1
snippets.notes_ja: テストのプレイヤーには音は聞こえず、どの音名が届いたかだけが記録されます。
snippets.notes_en: Test players do not hear audio; only the sound name that reached them is recorded.

snippets.title_ja: 押せる文字で投票させる
snippets.desc_ja: チャットの [賛成] [反対] を押すと /trigger が走る。書き方が 1.21.5 で変わった。
snippets.desc_en: Clicking [Yes] / [No] in chat runs /trigger. The syntax changed in 1.21.5.

lines: tellraw @a [{"text":"[賛成]","color":"green","clickEvent":{"action":"run_command","value":"/trigger vote set 1"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":"賛成に投票"}},{"text":"  "},{"text":"[反対]","color":"red","clickEvent":{"action":"run_command","value":"/trigger vote set 2"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":"反対に投票"}}]

tellraw @a [{text:"[賛成]",color:"green",click_event:{action:"run_command",command:"trigger vote set 1"},hover_event:{action:"show_text",value:"賛成に投票"}},{text:"  "},{text:"[反対]",color:"red",click_event:{action:"run_command",command:"trigger vote set 2"},hover_event:{action:"show_text",value:"反対に投票"}}]

snippets.notes_ja: 1.20.1 は JSON の clickEvent / hoverEvent、1.21.5 以降は SNBT の click_event(command)/ hover_event(value)。
snippets.notes_en: 1.20.1 uses JSON clickEvent / hoverEvent; 1.21.5+ uses SNBT click_event (command) / hover_event (value).

snippets.title_ja: 読み込み時の準備(load)
snippets.desc_ja: データパックを読み込んだときに1回だけ動く。項目・定数・ゲームルール。
snippets.desc_en: Runs once when the pack loads: objectives, constants, game rules.
lines: execute unless score #state game matches 0.. run scoreboard players set #state game 0
tellraw @a {"text":"ゲームを読み込みました","color":"green"}
snippets.notes_ja: #state が既にあれば上書きしないので、/reload しても試合が止まりません。
snippets.notes_en: #state is only set when missing, so /reload does not reset a running round.

snippets.title_ja: #state で場面を切り替える(毎 tick)
snippets.desc_ja: 0=ロビー 1=カウントダウン 2=試合中 3=終了。場面ごとの関数だけを呼ぶ。
snippets.desc_en: 0 lobby, 1 countdown, 2 playing, 3 ended. Only the current phase's function runs.
lines: # #state game: 0=ロビー 1=カウントダウン 2=試合中 3=終了
execute if score #state game matches 0 run function game:lobby_tick
execute if score #state game matches 1 run function game:countdown_tick
execute if score #state game matches 2 run function game:play_tick

also.label_ja: カウントダウン中(毎 tick)
lines: execute if score #cd game matches ..0 run scoreboard players set #state game 2

snippets.notes_ja: 呼ぶ関数が無いとデータパックの読み込みで失敗するので、中身が空でも3つとも作ります。
snippets.notes_en: A call to a missing function makes the pack fail to load, so create all three even if empty.

snippets.title_ja: 試合を始める
snippets.desc_ja: 得点を戻し、チームの場所へ移し、持ち物と効果を整えてから開始を知らせる。
snippets.desc_en: Reset scores, move teams to their spawns, set items and effects, announce the start.
lines: execute as @a at @s run playsound minecraft:entity.player.levelup master @s ~ ~ ~ 1 1

snippets.title_ja: 試合を終える
snippets.desc_ja: 勝ちを知らせ、全員を見る側にし、10秒後に元に戻す予約をする。
snippets.desc_en: Announce the result, make everyone watch, and schedule a reset in 10 seconds.
lines: execute if score Red points > Blue points run title @a title {"text":"赤チームの勝利","color":"red"}
execute if score Blue points > Red points run title @a title {"text":"青チームの勝利","color":"blue"}
execute if score Red points = Blue points run title @a title {"text":"引き分け","color":"white"}
execute as @a at @s run playsound minecraft:ui.toast.challenge_complete master @s ~ ~ ~ 1 1

snippets.title_ja: ロビーの開始ボタン(コマンドブロック)
snippets.desc_ja: 上にボタンの付いたインパルスから、チェーンで続けて動かす。
snippets.desc_en: An impulse block with a button on top, followed by chain blocks.

blocks.cmd: tellraw @a {"text":"ボタンが押されました。まもなく開始","color":"yellow"}
execute as @a at @s run playsound minecraft:block.note_block.pling master @s ~ ~ ~ 1 1

snippets.notes_ja: 1つ目を function game:start に替えるのがふつうです。押す動きは「プレイヤーの動き」の use_block(ボタンの座標は origin の1つ上)。
snippets.notes_en: Usually the first block is function game:start. To press it, use the use_block action on the block above origin.

snippets.title_ja: 感圧板を踏んだら開始
snippets.title_en: Start when someone steps on a pressure plate
snippets.desc_ja: インパルスの上に感圧板を置き、テストのプレイヤーを歩かせて踏ませる。
snippets.desc_en: Put a pressure plate on an impulse block and walk a test player onto it.

blocks.cmd: execute as @a at @s run playsound minecraft:entity.player.levelup master @s ~ ~ ~ 1 1

snippets.notes_ja: 感圧板は真下のブロックに動力を送るので、インパルスがそのまま動きます。trigger を none にして、置いた時点では動かないようにしています。
snippets.notes_en: A pressure plate powers the block under it, so the impulse block fires. trigger none keeps it from running when placed.

snippets.title_ja: 決まった場所に入ったら(リピート)
snippets.title_en: React when someone enters a spot (repeat)
snippets.desc_ja: 感圧板を使わず、座標の箱に人がいるかを常時調べる。
snippets.desc_en: No plate: an always-active repeat checks a box of coordinates.

blocks.cmd: execute as @a[x=12,y=-60,z=10,dx=2,dy=2,dz=2,tag=!goal] run tag @s add goal
tellraw @a [{"selector":"@a[tag=goal]","color":"gold"},{"text":" がゴールしました"}]

snippets.notes_ja: tag=!goal で1人1回だけ反応します。終わったら tag @a remove goal。
snippets.notes_en: tag=!goal makes it fire once per player. Clear it with tag @a remove goal.

snippets.title_ja: スポーン地点へ移す・復活地点を決める
snippets.title_en: Teleport to spawn and set respawn points
snippets.desc_ja: 全員を集め、死んだときに戻る場所も決める。
snippets.desc_en: Gather everyone and set where they respawn.

snippets.title_ja: 牢屋に入れて出られなくする
snippets.title_en: Jail players and keep them inside
snippets.desc_ja: 牢屋チームの人が箱の外に出たら戻す(毎 tick)。
snippets.desc_en: Every tick, send jail team members back if they leave the box.
lines: execute as @a[team=jail] unless entity @s[x=27,y=-61,z=27,dx=6,dy=5,dz=6] run tp @s 30 -60 30
snippets.notes_ja: dx/dy/dz の箱は (x,y,z) から +dx…まで。牢屋の中から壊されないよう adventure にします。
snippets.notes_en: The dx/dy/dz box spans from (x,y,z) to +dx and so on. Use adventure mode so the walls cannot be broken.

snippets.title_ja: ゲームモードと効果
snippets.desc_ja: 壊せない・お腹が減らない・鬼だけ速く光る、などの定番。
snippets.desc_en: Common setup: no block breaking, no hunger, hunters fast and glowing.
snippets.notes_ja: infinite は 1.19.4 から使えます。最後の true は粒を隠す指定。
snippets.notes_en: infinite works since 1.19.4. The final true hides particles.

snippets.title_ja: その場で動けなくする/戻す
snippets.desc_ja: カウントダウン中に動けなくする。1.20.1 は効果、1.21.x は属性で止める。
snippets.desc_en: Hold players during a countdown: effects in 1.20.1, attributes in 1.21.x.

lines: execute as @a run attribute @s minecraft:movement_speed base set 0
execute as @a run attribute @s minecraft:jump_strength base set 0
execute as @a run attribute @s minecraft:movement_speed base set 0.1
execute as @a run attribute @s minecraft:jump_strength base set 0.42

snippets.notes_ja: jump_boost 250 は内部で負の値になり、跳べなくなる昔からの技です。属性の名前は 1.21.2 で generic. が外れました。
snippets.notes_en: jump_boost 250 wraps to a negative level, which stops jumping. Attribute names lost the generic. prefix in 1.21.2.

snippets.title_ja: 死んだら観戦にする
snippets.desc_ja: デス数が増えた人を観戦モードにして、数を戻す(毎 tick)。
snippets.desc_en: Every tick, players whose death count rose become spectators.
lines: execute as @a[scores={died=1..}] run title @s title {"text":"脱落","color":"red"}
snippets.notes_ja: 1行目の objectives add は load に移すと毎 tick の無駄がありません。gamerule doImmediateRespawn true と組み合わせます。
snippets.notes_en: Move the objectives add line to load to avoid running it every tick. Pair it with gamerule doImmediateRespawn true.

snippets.title_ja: 持ち物を配る(壊れない剣・弓・色付き防具)
snippets.title_en: Give a kit (unbreakable sword, bow, dyed armor)
snippets.desc_ja: アイテムの書き方が 1.20.5 で NBT からコンポーネントに変わった代表例。
snippets.desc_en: The classic example of item NBT (1.20.1) vs item components (1.20.5+).
snippets.notes_ja: 色は 10進の RGB(赤 16711680・青 255)。1.21.5 から enchantments と dyed_color の書き方がさらに短くなりました。
snippets.notes_en: Colors are decimal RGB (red 16711680, blue 255). enchantments and dyed_color got shorter in 1.21.5.

snippets.title_ja: 名前と説明つきのアイテム
snippets.title_en: An item with a name and lore
snippets.desc_ja: 鬼だけが持つ「確保の棒」のような特別なアイテム。
snippets.desc_en: A special item such as the hunter's catching stick.

lines: give @a[team=hunter] minecraft:stick{display:{Name:'{"text":"確保の棒","color":"gold","italic":false}',Lore:['{"text":"逃走者をたたくと確保","color":"gray"}']}} 1
give @a[team=hunter] minecraft:stick[custom_name={text:"確保の棒",color:"gold",italic:false},lore=[{text:"逃走者をたたくと確保",color:"gray"}]] 1

snippets.notes_ja: 1.20.1 は名前を JSON の文字列で '…' に包みます。1.21.5 以降は SNBT の文字をそのまま書きます。
snippets.notes_en: 1.20.1 wraps the name as a JSON string in '...'; 1.21.5+ writes the SNBT text directly.

snippets.title_ja: 手に持っているかを調べる
snippets.title_en: Check what a player is holding
snippets.desc_ja: 1.20.1 は NBT の SelectedItem、1.20.5 以降は execute if items。
snippets.desc_en: 1.20.1 reads SelectedItem NBT; 1.20.5+ uses execute if items.

lines: execute as @a[nbt={SelectedItem:{id:"minecraft:stick"}}] run title @s actionbar {"text":"棒を持っている","color":"gold"}
execute as @a if items entity @s weapon.mainhand minecraft:stick run title @s actionbar {"text":"棒を持っている","color":"gold"}

snippets.title_ja: 効果がかかっているかを調べる
snippets.title_en: Check whether an effect is active
snippets.desc_ja: NBT の名前が 1.20.2 で ActiveEffects から active_effects に変わった。
snippets.desc_en: The NBT key changed from ActiveEffects to active_effects in 1.20.2.

lines: execute as @a[nbt={ActiveEffects:[{Id:14}]}] run title @s actionbar {"text":"透明になっている","color":"aqua"}
execute as @a[nbt={active_effects:[{id:"minecraft:invisibility"}]}] run title @s actionbar {"text":"透明になっている","color":"aqua"}

snippets.notes_ja: 1.20.1 は効果を番号で書きます(14 = 透明化)。
snippets.notes_en: 1.20.1 uses effect numbers (14 = invisibility).

snippets.title_ja: 金塊5個で剣と交換(trigger の店)
snippets.title_en: Trade 5 gold nuggets for a sword (trigger shop)
snippets.desc_ja: プレイヤーが /trigger shop を打つと、持ち物を数えて足りれば交換(毎 tick)。
snippets.desc_en: When a player runs /trigger shop, count their nuggets and trade if they have enough.
lines: execute as @a[scores={shop=1..}] store result score @s coins run clear @s minecraft:gold_nugget 0
execute as @a[scores={shop=1..,coins=..4}] run tellraw @s {"text":"金塊が足りません","color":"red"}
snippets.notes_ja: clear の数 0 は消さずに数えるだけ。trigger は一度使うと enable し直すまで打てません。
snippets.notes_en: clear with count 0 only counts. A trigger must be enabled again after each use.

snippets.title_ja: 倒したらご褒美
snippets.desc_ja: 毎 tick、新しく倒した人に金のりんごと音と一言。
snippets.desc_en: Every tick, give anyone who just got a kill a golden apple, a sound and a message.
lines: execute as @a[scores={newkill=1..}] run tellraw @a [{"selector":"@s","color":"gold"},{"text":" がキル！ 合計 "},{"score":{"name":"@s","objective":"kills"}}]
execute as @a[scores={newkill=1..}] at @s run playsound minecraft:entity.experience_orb.pickup master @s ~ ~ ~ 1 1
snippets.notes_ja: 合計(kills)と、毎 tick 0 に戻す方(newkill)の2つを使います。
snippets.notes_en: Use two objectives: a running total (kills) and one reset to 0 every tick (newkill).

snippets.title_ja: 復活したときの処理
snippets.desc_ja: @e[type=player] は生きている人だけを選ぶので、死んで戻ってきた瞬間を拾える。
snippets.desc_en: @e[type=player] only selects living players, so it catches the moment someone respawns.

snippets.title_ja: チームの合計キルで勝敗
snippets.desc_ja: 倒した人のチームに1点、先に10点で勝ち。
snippets.desc_en: One point to the killer's team; first to 10 wins.
lines: execute as @a[team=red,scores={newkill=1..}] run scoreboard players add Red points 1
execute as @a[team=blue,scores={newkill=1..}] run scoreboard players add Blue points 1
execute if score #state game matches 2 if score Red points matches 10.. run title @a title {"text":"赤チームの勝利","color":"red"}
execute if score #state game matches 2 if score Blue points matches 10.. run title @a title {"text":"青チームの勝利","color":"blue"}
execute if score #state game matches 2 if score Red points matches 10.. run scoreboard players set #state game 3
execute if score #state game matches 2 if score Blue points matches 10.. run scoreboard players set #state game 3
snippets.notes_ja: 「倒したらご褒美」の newkill を 0 に戻す行より前に置きます。
snippets.notes_en: Put it before the line that resets newkill to 0 in the reward snippet.

snippets.title_ja: 最後まで残ったチームの勝ち
snippets.desc_ja: 観戦になっていない人が片方のチームにしかいなければ終わり。
snippets.desc_en: End the round when only one team still has non-spectators.
lines: execute if score #state game matches 2 unless entity @a[team=blue,gamemode=!spectator] if entity @a[team=red,gamemode=!spectator] run title @a title {"text":"赤チームの勝利","color":"red"}
execute if score #state game matches 2 unless entity @a[team=red,gamemode=!spectator] if entity @a[team=blue,gamemode=!spectator] run title @a title {"text":"青チームの勝利","color":"blue"}
execute if score #state game matches 2 unless entity @a[team=blue,gamemode=!spectator] run scoreboard players set #state game 3
execute if score #state game matches 2 unless entity @a[team=red,gamemode=!spectator] run scoreboard players set #state game 3

snippets.title_ja: 逃走中の準備
snippets.desc_ja: ハンター・逃走者・確保のチーム、賞金と被ダメージの項目、落下ダメージなし。
snippets.desc_en: Hunter, runner and jail teams; money and damage objectives; no fall damage.
lines: scoreboard objectives add money dummy {"text":"賞金","color":"gold"}
snippets.notes_ja: 落下や溺れでも hurt が増えるので、落下ダメージを切っておきます。
snippets.notes_en: Falling also raises hurt, so fall damage is turned off.

snippets.title_ja: たたかれたら確保(damage_taken)
snippets.desc_ja: ダメージを受けた逃走者を確保し、たたいたハンターの確保数を増やす。
snippets.desc_en: A hurt runner is caught; the hunter who hit them gets a catch.
lines: execute as @a[team=runner,scores={hurt=1..}] on attacker run scoreboard players add @s catches 1
execute as @a[team=runner,scores={hurt=1..}] run tellraw @a [{"selector":"@s","color":"red"},{"text":" 確保！","color":"red"}]
execute as @a[team=runner,scores={hurt=1..}] at @s run playsound minecraft:block.anvil.land master @a ~ ~ ~ 1 1
snippets.notes_ja: execute on attacker は 1.19.4 から。同じ tick の中で tp → team join の順にしないと、先にチームが変わって tp されません。
snippets.notes_en: execute on attacker exists since 1.19.4. Teleport before changing team, or the runner selector no longer matches.

snippets.title_ja: 1秒ごとに賞金を増やす
snippets.desc_ja: 20 tick ごとに逃走者全員へ 100 円。
snippets.desc_en: Every 20 ticks, give every runner 100.
lines: execute if score #state game matches 2 run scoreboard players add #mt game 1
execute if score #mt game matches 20.. run scoreboard players add @a[team=runner] money 100
execute if score #mt game matches 20.. run scoreboard players set #mt game 0
snippets.notes_ja: アクションバーの @s は各逃走者に置き換わります(title の宛先ごとに計算)。
snippets.notes_en: @s in the action bar text resolves per runner.

snippets.title_ja: 鬼ごっこ: たたかれた人が次の鬼
snippets.desc_ja: たたかれた逃げる側が鬼に、今の鬼は逃げる側に。新しい鬼は3秒動きが遅い。
snippets.desc_en: The hit runner becomes the hunter, the old hunter runs; the new hunter is slowed for 3 s.
lines: execute if entity @a[tag=new_oni] run team join runner @a[team=hunter]
execute as @a[tag=new_oni] run tellraw @a [{"selector":"@s","color":"dark_red"},{"text":" が鬼になった"}]

snippets.title_ja: 自首ボタン
snippets.desc_ja: ボタンの近くの逃走者が自首して賞金を確定する。
snippets.desc_en: The runner next to the button surrenders and keeps their money.
snippets.notes_ja: ボタンから動くコマンドブロックには @s がいないので、@p で近くの人を選びます。
snippets.notes_en: A button-powered block has no @s, so @p picks the nearest player.

snippets.title_ja: テスト: ハンターが逃走者をたたく
snippets.title_en: Test: the hunter hits a runner
snippets.desc_ja: プレイヤーの動き。Alice が Bob に近づいてたたき、確保が見えたかを調べる。
snippets.desc_en: Player actions: Alice chases and hits Bob; check that the catch was shown.
snippets.notes_ja: 「逃走中の準備」と「たたかれたら確保」を先に入れておきます。
snippets.notes_en: Add the setup and the catch-on-hit snippets first.

snippets.title_ja: 役職をこっそり配る(タグ)
snippets.desc_ja: 人狼1人・占い師1人・残りは村人。本人にだけタイトルで伝える。
snippets.desc_en: One werewolf, one seer, the rest villagers; each sees only their own role.
snippets.notes_ja: タグは他の人の画面には出ません。人数に合わせて tag @r[tag=!wolf] add wolf を足せば人狼が増えます。
snippets.notes_en: Tags are invisible to others. Repeat tag @r[tag=!wolf] add wolf for more werewolves.

snippets.title_ja: 投票を始める(番号と /trigger)
snippets.desc_ja: 生きている人に番号を振って一覧を出し、/trigger vote set 番号 で投票させる。
snippets.desc_en: Number the living players, list them, and let them vote with /trigger vote set N.
lines: tellraw @a {"text":"/trigger vote set 番号 で投票してください","color":"yellow"}

snippets.title_ja: 票を数えて追放する
snippets.desc_ja: 候補ごとに自分の番号へ入った票を数え、最多が1人なら追放、同票なら追放なし。
snippets.desc_en: Count votes for each candidate; banish a single top vote-getter, nobody on a tie.
lines: execute as @a[tag=alive] run scoreboard players operation #max game > @s votes
execute as @a[tag=alive] if score @s votes = #max game run tag @s add top
execute store result score #ntop game if entity @a[tag=top]
execute if score #ntop game matches 1 if score #max game matches 1.. run tellraw @a [{"selector":"@a[tag=top]","color":"red"},{"text":" が追放されました"}]
execute if score #ntop game matches 1 if score #max game matches 1.. run gamemode spectator @a[tag=top]
execute if score #ntop game matches 1 if score #max game matches 1.. run tag @a[tag=top] remove alive
execute if score #ntop game matches 2.. run tellraw @a {"text":"同票のため追放なし","color":"gray"}
execute as @a[tag=alive] if score @s vote = #me game run scoreboard players add #cnt game 1

snippets.notes_ja: 誰も投票しないと #max が 0 のままなので追放されません。
snippets.notes_en: With no votes #max stays 0 and nobody is banished.

snippets.title_ja: テスト: 2人が同じ人に投票
snippets.title_en: Test: two players vote for the same person
snippets.desc_ja: プレイヤーがチャットで /trigger を打つ動き。
snippets.desc_en: Players type /trigger in chat.
snippets.notes_ja: 「投票を始める」を先に流しておきます(enable されていないと trigger は拒否されます)。
snippets.notes_en: Run 'open the vote' first; a trigger that is not enabled is refused.

snippets.title_ja: 夜と昼を切り替える
snippets.desc_ja: 夜は人狼以外を目隠し、昼は解除。時間の流れは止めておく。
snippets.desc_en: At night blind everyone but the werewolves; clear it by day. Daylight cycle is stopped.

snippets.title_ja: 勝敗の判定
snippets.desc_ja: 生きている人狼と村側を数え、人狼0なら村、人狼が村側以上なら人狼の勝ち。
snippets.desc_en: Count living wolves and others; villagers win at 0 wolves, wolves win when they equal or outnumber.
lines: execute store result score #wolves game if entity @a[tag=alive,tag=wolf]
execute store result score #village game if entity @a[tag=alive,tag=!wolf]
execute if score #wolves game matches 0 run title @a title {"text":"村人の勝利","color":"green"}
execute if score #wolves game matches 1.. if score #wolves game >= #village game run title @a title {"text":"人狼の勝利","color":"red"}

snippets.title_ja: 拠点を取り合う(占領ゲージ)
snippets.title_en: Control point with a capture meter
snippets.desc_ja: 半径5の中にいる人数で -100〜100 のゲージを動かし、取り切ったチームに毎秒1点。
snippets.desc_en: A -100..100 meter moved by who stands within 5 blocks; the owning team scores 1 per second.
lines: execute positioned 0 -60 30 store result score #red_a game if entity @a[team=red,distance=..5,gamemode=!spectator]
execute positioned 0 -60 30 store result score #blue_a game if entity @a[team=blue,distance=..5,gamemode=!spectator]
execute if score #red_a game matches 1.. if score #blue_a game matches 0 if score #cp_a game matches ..99 run scoreboard players add #cp_a game 1
execute if score #blue_a game matches 1.. if score #red_a game matches 0 if score #cp_a game matches -99.. run scoreboard players remove #cp_a game 1
execute if score #cp_t game matches 20.. if score #cp_a game matches 100 run scoreboard players add Red points 1
execute if score #cp_t game matches 20.. if score #cp_a game matches -100 run scoreboard players add Blue points 1
execute if score #cp_t game matches 20.. run scoreboard players set #cp_t game 0
execute positioned 0 -60 30 run title @a[distance=..5] actionbar [{"text":"拠点A "},{"score":{"name":"#cp_a","objective":"game"}}]
snippets.notes_ja: 両方のチームがいると止まります(取り合い中)。拠点を増やすなら座標と #cp_b などを替えて複製します。
snippets.notes_en: With both teams inside, the meter stops (contested). Copy it with new coordinates and #cp_b for more points.

snippets.title_ja: 拠点のゲージをボスバーに
snippets.title_en: Show the capture meter on a boss bar
snippets.desc_ja: -100〜100 を 0〜200 にずらして表示し、持ち主で色を変える。
snippets.desc_en: Shift -100..100 to 0..200 for the bar and color it by owner.
lines: execute store result bossbar game:point_a value run scoreboard players get #cp_bar game
execute if score #cp_a game matches 1.. run bossbar set game:point_a color red
execute if score #cp_a game matches ..-1 run bossbar set game:point_a color blue
execute if score #cp_a game matches 0 run bossbar set game:point_a color white

snippets.title_ja: 攻城戦: コアを壊したら勝ち
snippets.title_en: Siege: break the core to win
snippets.desc_ja: ビーコンをコアにし、壊せるつるはしを攻める側にだけ渡す。adventure でも壊せる指定は版で書き方が違う。
snippets.desc_en: A beacon is the core; only attackers get a pickaxe that may break it. The adventure-mode permission differs by version.

lines: execute if score #state game matches 2 unless block 0 -60 20 minecraft:beacon run title @a title {"text":"コアが壊された！ 赤の勝利","color":"red"}
execute if score #state game matches 2 unless block 0 -60 20 minecraft:beacon run scoreboard players set #state game 3

snippets.title_ja: リピート(常時)+条件付きチェーン
snippets.desc_ja: 条件が成り立ったときだけ後ろのチェーンが動く。
snippets.desc_en: The chain blocks only run when the repeat block's check succeeds.
snippets.notes_ja: tag Alice add winner を打つと1回だけ動きます。条件付きは「すぐ後ろのブロックが成功したか」を見ます。
snippets.notes_en: Run tag Alice add winner to fire it once. Conditional means 'did the block just behind me succeed'.

snippets.title_ja: インパルス+チェーンで1回だけ
snippets.desc_ja: レッドストーンブロックで1回押し、続けて全部動かす。
snippets.desc_en: Powered once by a redstone block; the whole line runs in order.
snippets.notes_ja: チェーンは「常時実行」が既定です(必要入力にすると動きません)。
snippets.notes_en: Chain blocks default to always active (needs-redstone chains do not run).

snippets.title_ja: チェーンを上に曲げる
snippets.desc_ja: 2つ目の向きを up にすると、3つ目はその上に置かれる。狭い場所で長い列を組むとき。
snippets.desc_en: Setting the second block's facing to up puts the third one above it; handy in tight spaces.
snippets.notes_ja: 向き(facing)はそのブロックが「次」を指す方向です。エディタの配置図で確かめられます。
snippets.notes_en: facing is the direction a block points to the next one. Check it in the editor's layout map.

snippets.title_ja: リピートで時計を回す
snippets.desc_ja: 試合中だけ毎 tick 数を足す。データパックを使わない場合の tick の代わり。
snippets.desc_en: Counts every tick while playing; a tick function substitute without a data pack.

blocks.cmd: execute if score #state game matches 2 run scoreboard players add #ticks game 1
execute if score #ticks game matches 20.. run scoreboard players remove #time game 1
execute if score #ticks game matches 20.. run scoreboard players set #ticks game 0

snippets.title_ja: ボタンでマップを元に戻す(clone)
snippets.title_en: Reset the map with a button (clone)
snippets.desc_ja: 保存しておいた見本の区画を競技場へ写す。
snippets.desc_en: Copy a saved template area over the arena.

blocks.cmd: tellraw @a {"text":"マップを元に戻しました","color":"aqua"}

snippets.notes_ja: 見本と競技場の座標は自分のマップに合わせます。読み込まれていない場所は clone できません。
snippets.notes_en: Adjust both areas to your map. clone fails on chunks that are not loaded.

snippets.title_ja: 座標を渡して移動(マクロ)
snippets.desc_ja: $ で始まる行の $(x) などが、呼ぶときの値に置き換わる。
snippets.desc_en: $(x) in lines starting with $ is replaced by the values passed in.
snippets.notes_ja: マクロは 1.20.2 から。$ で始めない行に $(…) を書いても置き換わりません。
snippets.notes_en: Macros start in 1.20.2. $(...) is only replaced in lines that start with $.

snippets.title_ja: ストレージの値をマクロに渡す
snippets.title_en: Pass storage values to a macro
snippets.desc_ja: 設定をストレージに置き、function … with storage で渡す。
snippets.desc_en: Keep settings in storage and pass them with function ... with storage.
lines: data modify storage game:cfg lobby set value {x:0,y:-60,z:0}
execute as @a run function game:tp_to with storage game:cfg lobby

snippets.title_ja: スコアの数を文字に埋め込む
snippets.title_en: Put a score into text with a macro
snippets.desc_ja: 数をストレージに写してからマクロで文字に入れる。
snippets.desc_en: Copy a score into storage, then use a macro to place it in text.
lines: execute store result storage game:tmp n int 1 run scoreboard players get #time game
snippets.notes_ja: 単に数を見せるだけなら score の文字部品で足ります。マクロはコマンドの引数そのものに数を入れたいとき。
snippets.notes_en: To just show a number, a score text component is enough; macros are for putting a number into a command argument.

snippets.title_ja: サイコロ(random、1.20.2+)
snippets.desc_ja: 1〜6 の乱数をスコアに入れ、出た目で分ける。
snippets.desc_en: Store a 1-6 random number in a score and branch on it.
lines: execute store result score #dice game run random value 1..6
execute if score #dice game matches 6 run tellraw @a {"text":"大当たり！","color":"gold"}
snippets.notes_ja: 1.20.1 には random がありません。1.20.1 では @r や tag を使った方法にします。
snippets.notes_en: 1.20.1 has no random command; use @r and tags there.

snippets.title_ja: 1秒ごとに自分を呼ぶループ
snippets.title_en: A loop that calls itself every second
snippets.desc_ja: tick を使わずに1秒ごとの処理を回す。残り0で止まる。
snippets.desc_en: Run something every second without tick; stops at 0.
lines: execute store result bossbar game:time value run scoreboard players get #time game
execute if score #time game matches 1.. run schedule function game:every_second 1s
execute if score #time game matches ..0 run title @a title {"text":"時間切れ","color":"red"}
snippets.notes_ja: 部品の id を every_second にします。schedule は同じ関数の予約を上書きするので二重に回りません。ボスバーは「ボスバーで残り時間」で作っておきます。
snippets.notes_en: Save it as every_second. schedule replaces an existing schedule of the same function, so it never runs twice. Create the boss bar with the boss bar snippet.

snippets.title_ja: 5秒後に1回だけ
snippets.desc_ja: あとで動かしたい処理を予約する。止めるときは schedule clear。
snippets.desc_en: Book something to run later; cancel it with schedule clear.
snippets.notes_ja: 時間は 20t・5s・1d のように単位つき。単位なしは tick です。
snippets.notes_en: Times take a unit (20t, 5s, 1d); a bare number means ticks.
